title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Gerente de Serviços - Husqvarna Construção
description:
Olá, somos o Grupo Husqvarna, o maior produtor mundial de produtos de energia ao ar livre para Floresta & Jardim e Construção. Como uma das start-ups mais antigas do mundo, estamos em uma jornada emocionante, trabalhando juntos em um ambiente global acelerado, onde nos desafiamos continuamente a continuar inovando e reinventando nossos negócios. Com nossa paixão pela inovação, criamos produtos e serviços para clientes em todo o mundo. Somos um empregador de oportunidades iguais e entendemos que nossas diferenças são nossos pontos fortes. Somos curiosos, ousados e construídos por nossas diferenças. Celebramos a diversidade e estamos comprometidos em criar um ambiente inclusivo para todos os funcionários e candidatos. Juntos como uma equipe, podemos dar vida às melhores ideias.


Se você se identificou com a descrição acima, cheque esta posição para Gerente de Serviços, para atuar no Brasil em nosso time da Divisão de Construção.


Objetivo da Função

Como Gerente de Serviços, você será o principal elo de relacionamento entre clientes, fornecedores, distribuidores, equipe técnica e áreas internas globais da Husqvarna. Seu papel será liderar o time de serviços técnicos, garantindo excelência em reparos, suporte, treinamentos e melhoria contínua dos processos que sustentam nossa operação de pós-venda na Divisão de Construção.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Liderar e desenvolver a equipe de técnicos de serviços (reparos, treinamentos e suporte pós-venda).

Conduzir o desenvolvimento e implementação de um novo Centro de Serviços (Repair Center).

Realizar o planejamento, controle e análise de processos de garantia.

Estruturar e gerir a política de treinamentos internos e externos.

Administrar a rede de assistências técnicas autorizadas.

Gerenciar performance e resultados de vendas de peças, acessórios e serviços.

Liderar processos de claim reports, incluindo campanhas de recall e reembolsos por problemas recorrentes.

Gerenciar informações de Masterdata (JDE) garantindo precisão e atualização contínua.

Atuar em colaboração direta com áreas internas como Vendas, Finanças, Customer Service, Tech Support e Categoria de Produtos — incluindo times na Suécia — para melhoria contínua dos processos.


Requisitos:

Formação superior em Engenharia Mecânica ou áreas correlatas.

Inglês Avançado/Fluente (capacidade de conduzir calls e projetos globais).

Experiência prévia em gestão de equipes técnicas, serviços ou pós-venda.

Vivência com centros de reparo, garantia, treinamentos técnicos ou suporte ao cliente será um diferencial.

Capacidade analítica e visão de processos para otimização contínua.

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

description:
Senior Operations Data Analyst

100% Remote (Brazil-Based) | US-Based Company | Paid in USD/hour


We are hiring for a leading US-based luxury resale and eCommerce company transforming how high-end fashion is bought and sold globally.


We are looking for a Senior Operations Data Analyst with a strong analytics mindset, solid SQL expertise, and proven experience working closely with business teams. This is a high-impact role focused on operational performance, business clarity, and strategic decision-making.


About the Role


You will deliver quantitative insights to support our Operations organization, partnering closely with teams across:


  • Inventory
  • Logistics
  • Retail
  • Customer Service
  • Tech & Finance


This is a business-focused analytics role, not pure research or advanced modeling. The day-to-day work includes:


  • Explaining performance changes (“why did this move?”)
  • Turning open-ended business questions into structured analysis
  • Designing and defining KPIs
  • Measuring operational efficiency across receiving, authentication, launch, and outbound workflows
  • Translating business needs into technical solutions

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

Somos o grupo educacional mais diversificado do país. Todos os dias, criamos futuros incríveis através da inovação. Colocamos a mão na massa para tirar as ideias do papel e colocá-las em prática. Enfrentamos desafios com resiliência e nos adaptamos às mudanças constantes.


Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #JeitoCogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.


Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Executar ativações comerciais em empresas, órgãos públicos, escolas e eventos em geral para promoção e divulgação da marca com foco em captação;
  • Ser responsável pela gestão do funil de vendas;
  • Desenvolver sua rede digital de captação, gerando novos leads, através de eventos, lives, publicação de conteúdo, ebooks, cursos livres e webinar;
  • Ser responsável pela gestão dos indicadores comerciais;
  • Realizar prospecção de clientes;
  • Atender com foco na experiência do aluno/candidato;
  • Terá atuação interna e externa.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Ensino superior completo ou cursando;
  • Experiência na área comercial;
  • Veículo próprio;
  • CNH;
  • Pacote office básico.


Informações adicionais:


Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Executivo(a) de Contas Sênior
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA


Empresa de tecnologia fiscal que desenvolve soluções para automatizar rotinas tributárias, aplicar corretamente a legislação e aumentar a eficiência operacional das áreas fiscais.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Executivo(a) de Contas Sênior que será o parceiro estratégico de nossos maiores clientes. Responsável por gerenciar uma carteira de alto valor, o objetivo é garantir o posicionamento e adoção das soluções fiscais e expansão da receita (up-sell/cross-sell). Este profissional atua consultivamente, unindo conhecimento técnico de legislação tributária brasileira com a tecnologia da nossa plataforma.


RESPONSABILIDADES DA VAGA:

  • Mínimo de 5-7 anos em gestão de contas ou vendas consultivas (B2B SaaS), preferencialmente no setor de tecnologia, contabilidade (Outsourcing de serviços) ou consultoria tributária.
  • Gestão Estratégica da Carteira (KAE): Desenvolver e implementar planos estratégicos para cada conta, alinhando as soluções da empresa com os objetivos de compliance e eficiência fiscal do cliente.
  • Consultoria de Valor: Agir como consultor de confiança, demonstrando como a plataforma fiscal otimiza processos, reduz riscos e automatiza as obrigações tributárias.
  • Relacionamento C-Level: Construir e manter relacionamentos sólidos com decisores (Diretores Fiscais, CFOs, Gerentes de TI).
  • Análise de Desempenho (QBRs): Conduzir Business Reviews Trimestrais (QBRs) para apresentar valor, métricas de ROI, conformidade fiscal e tendências de mercado.
  • Gestão de Pipeline: Manter o CRM (Pipedrive ou Salesforce) atualizado com previsões precisas de receita e atividades da conta.
  • Interface Interna: Colaborar com equipes de Produto, Suporte e Delivery para resolver problemas complexos e repassar feedbacks do mercado.


REQUISITOS NECESSÁRIOS/OBRIGATÓRIOS:

  • Conhecimento de plataformas de ERP, principalmente SAP nos módulos de finanças e integrações (BTP, GRC, DRC, etc)
  • Conhecimento de plataformas fiscais de mercado
  • Inglês Fluente


FORMAÇÃO NECESSÁRIA:

Superior completo em Administração, Contabilidade, Direito ou áreas de Technologies.


REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS – DIFERENCIAL:

Bons conhecimentos em impostos indiretos, obrigações acessórias e legislação tributária brasileira.


Benefícios

  • Vale refeição (Flex).
  • Convênio médico SulAmérica (coparticipação).
  • Convênio odontológico SulAmérica.
  • Seguro-viagem nacional e internacional.
  • Auxílio filho com deficiência.
  • Seguro de Vida.
  • Auxílio creche.
  • Wellhub (Gympass).
  • LinkedIn Learning
  • Parceria de desconto em cursos/treinamentos de SAP.
  • Parceria de desconto em cursos de inglês.
  • Outras facilidades e parcerias de descontos.


Outras Informações

  • Carga horária: das 9:00h às 18:00h
  • Modalidade de trabalho: Híbrido
  • Cidade: São Paulo - SP

title: Analista Atuarial Júnior
description:
Somos o Banesprev, um time focado em identificar melhores alternativas para fazer sempre melhor.

Temos Vaga em nosso time de Atuária, então essa é a hora de se juntar à nossa equipe.


Contando um pouco sobre nós...


Estamos como a 7ª maior entidade fechada de previdência complementar do Brasil e sem fins lucrativos.

Nosso objetivo é administrar planos de benefícios complementares de aposentadoria dos funcionários pertencentes à Banesprev, Cabesp e ao Grupo Santander, que é o nosso principal patrocinador.


Qual é a missão da área atuarial dentro do Banesprev:

Apoiar no aprimoramento e na automatização dos processos, revisando/desenvolvendo críticas para análise e validação da base de dados, com a finalidade de assegurar as informações que serão utilizadas para o cálculo do passivo atuarial e relatórios gerenciais.

Apoiar no desenvolvimento de metodologia para acompanhar, monitorar, mitigar e identificar os riscos de cadastro, além de aprimorar a gestão atuarial, em conformidade com as boas práticas de mercado.

Atender as demandas da PREVIC sobre os temas atuariais relacionados aos Planos de Benefícios.

Elaborar relatórios periódicos e contribuir com análises atuariais na tomada de decisão pela alta gestão da Entidade.

Apoiar na análise e críticas de testes de aderência de hipóteses e pareceres atuariais de consultoria atuarial externa.

Assegurar a aderência dos processos à Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados – LGPD nos processos da área.


As principais responsabilidades são:


1. Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados

Assegurar a aderência dos processos à Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados – LGPD nos processos da área.

2. Dados de participantes e assistidos ao atuário (interno e externo)

Gerar, formatar, analisar, consistir e encaminhar, dados de participantes ativos, autopatrocinados, BPD e assistidos, por meio de planilhas e relatórios, a fim de prover o atuário externo de informações necessárias ao cálculo das reservas matemáticas e avaliação atuarial dos planos e garantir a integridade e qualidade das informações utilizadas na Entidade.

3. Obrigações Legais – PREVIC

Gerar, analisar, consistir e encaminhar à Previc, as informações participantes e assistidos em atendimento à legislação pertinente, além de informações relacionadas aos processos atuariais da entidade.

4. Informações Gerenciais

Elaborar periodicamente relatórios, tabelas e gráficos com o propósito de informar gerência e diretoria sobre os dados relevantes de participantes, assistidos e situação financeira dos planos de benefícios.

5. Procedimentos e Normas

Elaborar/Manter atualizado os manuais de procedimentos e normas operacionais, a fim de preservar a continuidade das atividades atuariais pertinentes.

6. Suporte Gerência e Diretoria

Suportar discussões técnicas com base na legislação vigente e modelos dos planos de benefícios.

Dar suporte interno sobre os impactos atuariais que envolvem os cálculos de benefícios, contribuições e quaisquer outras questões pertinentes aos regulamentos dos planos.

7. Avaliação Atuarial

Sugerir e discutir premissas atuariais com base em estudos de aderência de hipóteses e de taxas de juros, bem como avaliar os resultados das avaliações atuariais elaboradas por consultoria externa.

Conhecimentos técnicos necessários:


  • Superior Completo em Ciências Atuariais.
  • Experiência na área atuarial em entidades fechadas/abertas de previdência complementar e consultorias técnico atuarial.
  • Pacote Office – nível avançado;


Desejável que você tenha:


  • MIBA - Registro no Instituto Brasileiro de Atuária.
  • Conhecimento em Power BI;
  • Desenvolvimento de modelos;
  • Inferência estatística.


Competências Organizacionais:


Comunicação; Iniciativa; Trabalho em Equipe; Pensamento crítico; Foco em melhoria de processo; Solução de problemas; Compromisso com a empresa; Foco no Cliente; Compromisso com a qualidade; Flexibilidade e Adaptação; Planejamento e Organização; Criatividade e Inovação; Vontade de Aprender Continuamente;


Competências Técnicas:


Experiência na área atuarial de Entidades Fechadas e Abertas de Previdência Complementar ou Consultorias Técnico Atuarial, conhecimento da legislação de previdência complementar fechada e tributária, inglês básico desejável, habilidade com matemática financeira, noções de contabilidade, habilidade em softwares para análise de grandes volumes de dados.

title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Fully Remote - Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).


Sphere Pay is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

Sphere Pay is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

description:
Job Responsibilities:

  • Conduct online live and offline practical training for the target language, ensuring training plans are executed on schedule.

title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Fully Remote - Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).


Sphere Pay is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

Sphere Pay is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Descrição da Empresa Microlins Ribeirão das Neves.

Descrição do Cargo A Microlins está em busca de um Professor de Inglês dedicado em busca da sua primeira oportunidade para se juntar à nossa equipe em Ribeirão das Neves, MG. A posição consiste em acompanhar aulas presenciais de inglês para estudantes de diferentes níveis de conhecimento. As responsabilidades diárias incluem planejar e preparar aulas, avaliar o progresso dos alunos e aplicar métodos pedagógicos para facilitar a aprendizagem de forma dinâmica e eficaz. Este é um cargo com carga horaria maleável e requer presença no local.

Qualificações

  • Ensino de Inglês : Experiência com a língua inglesa, com habilidades em adaptação a diferentes estilos de aprendizagem de alunos e aplicação prática do idioma.
  • Planejamento de Aulas : Capacidade de desenvolver planos de aula estruturados e dinâmicos que atendam às necessidades educacionais dos alunos.
  • Educação e Ensino : Conhecimento em práticas pedagógicas voltadas para o aprendizado efetivo e engajador.
  • Comunicação : Habilidade de comunicação clara e inspiradora, tanto verbal como escrita, para promover a interação e o engajamento dos estudantes.
  • Diferencial : Formação em Letras com especialização em Língua Inglesa ou certificações de proficiência em inglês (como TOEFL, IELTS, ou CAE) são diferenciais.

title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Fully Remote - Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).


Sphere Pay is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

Sphere Pay is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-End
description:
Sobre a OPEN Solutions


Somos a OPEN Solutions , uma empresa inovadora especializada no desenvolvimento de soluções para a indústria, integradas ao SAP ERP . Atuamos com tecnologia em nuvem e integração de sensores no chão de fábrica, levando eficiência, controle e inteligência operacional aos nossos clientes.


Com um time de 31 pessoas e sede em São José dos Campos/SP , transformamos ideias em software que gera impacto real na gestão industrial.


Nosso principal produto, OPEN Manufacturing / OPEN MES , integra PCP e chão de fábrica aos sistemas ERP e APS, apoiando empresas na jornada da Indústria 4.0 .


Nossa visão é ambiciosa: levar nossas soluções ao mercado global e alcançar 17 mil usuários até 2027 .


Oportunidade: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-End


Requisitos:

·       Conhecimento em .NET e C#.

·       Noções de bancos de dados relacionais (SQL, SAP HANA) e não relacionais (MongoDB).

·       Conhecimento de APIs RESTful ou GraphQL.

·       Noções de controle de versão com Git.

·       Familiaridade com ferramentas de CI/CD e testes automatizados.

·       Familiaridade com arquiteturas de microsserviços.

·       Conceitos de segurança em desenvolvimento back-end.


O que oferecemos:

  • Contrato PJ
  • Modelo de trabalho 100% presencial (localidade: São José dos Campos/SP) - precisa residir na cidade ou região
  • Ajuda de custo: R$ 48,00/por dia útil
  • Wellhub
  • Programa OPEN Mind - 50% do valor de capacitações custeado pela empresa
  • Day-off no mês de aniversário
  • Recesso de 30 dias/ano, sem desconto na remuneração
  • Equipamento de trabalho


Informações adicionais

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Fully Remote - Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).


Sphere Pay is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

Sphere Pay is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

title: Account Manager
description:
• LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
  • WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world’s biggest problems?
  • BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world?


Oneday is a VC-backed EdTech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.


We have raised $20M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.


We’re looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.


What you’ll do..

As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:

  • Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who’ve already shown interest
  • Understand what they’re building, why it matters, and where they’re stuck
  • Clearly position Oneday’s programs and mentorship
  • Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
  • Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
  • Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
  • Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates


This is not a passive customer success role.

It’s a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.


You’ll likely do well here if you:

  • Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
  • Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
  • Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
  • Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
  • Take feedback well and apply it
  • Have strong written and spoken English skills
  • Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results


What you’ll get:

  • Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
  • Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

title: Supervisor de Operações (Vaga exclusiva para PCD)
description:
Vaga exclusiva para PCD


Será responsável pela supervisão diária de um grupo de atendentes de contact center. Esta posição garante que as métricas de desempenho sejam alcançadas por meio de coaching adequado, motivação e responsabilidade.


Funções Essenciais / Responsabilidades Principais

  • Responsável pela supervisão diária de um grupo de associados do call center, incluindo o monitoramento de trabalho e assiduidade, de acordo com a política da organização e os requisitos legais aplicáveis.
  • Realizar coaching eficaz com os subordinados diretos sobre seu desempenho regularmente (no mínimo semanalmente) para garantir o alcance das métricas.
  • Identificar problemas relacionados ao desempenho, desenvolver planos de ação para melhoria e implementar ações corretivas, incluindo a rescisão do contrato de trabalho, se necessário.
  • Garantir que o serviço entregue aos nossos clientes atenda aos Indicadores Chave de Desempenho (KPIs ) contratuais e às expectativas financeiras.
  • Comunicar expectativas aos funcionários e fornecer atualizações em tempo hábil.
  • Atuar como especialista no assunto (SME) para lidar com chamadas de clientes escalonadas, conforme necessário.
  • Conduzir reuniões de equipe para garantir a comunicação rápida de informações relevantes e servir como um fórum aberto para sugestões. Agendar e organizar atividades de equipe.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre os processos de trabalho internos, políticas e procedimentos. Participar dos treinamentos obrigatórios de desenvolvimento de gestores.
  • Promover os valores da Concentrix por meio de comportamento e atitude, sendo inclusive um defensor dos membros da equipe.


Perfil do Candidato

  • Ensino superior completo ou cursando.
  • Experiência na função.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar bem sob pressão e acompanhar itens até a sua conclusão.
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação, tanto escrita quanto verbal.
  • Capacidade de liderar a equipe em multitarefas, priorização e cumprimento de prazos de entrega.

description:
• LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
  • WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world’s biggest problems?
  • BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world?


Oneday is a VC-backed EdTech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.


We have raised $20M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.


We’re looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.


What you’ll do..

As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:

  • Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who’ve already shown interest
  • Understand what they’re building, why it matters, and where they’re stuck
  • Clearly position Oneday’s programs and mentorship
  • Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
  • Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated

  • Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates


This is not a passive customer success role.

It’s a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.


You’ll likely do well here if you:

  • Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
  • Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly

  • Have strong written and spoken English skills

  • Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
  • Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers

title: Senior API Engineer (NodeJS, TS, SDUI)
description:
About the Company:

Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.


Role summary:

Lead the design and operation of APIs that power Server-Driven UI for Flutter clients while owning backend services across the stack. You’ll design stable UI contracts and compose client payloads, be comfortable diving into other backend codebases to implement features and fix production issues, participate in the on-call rotation to keep services healthy and low-latency, and drive team capability for SDUI.


Key responsibilities:

  • Design and implement robust RESTful APIs for SDUI, auth, and rate limiting.
  • Implement composition/templating logic that returns client-ready UI payloads with capability-aware fallbacks.
  • Champion SDUI capability across the team: coach engineers, run hands-on workshops, create onboarding/docs, and promote SDUI best practices.
  • Work across multiple backend repositories: add features, refactor, and maintain code quality.
  • Operate production services: own SLAs, alerting, runbooks, incident response, and participate in on-call rotation.
  • Improve reliability and performance (caching, CDN strategies, Redis, profiling, autoscaling, and load testing).
  • Build and maintain CI/CD, testing, and observability (metrics, tracing, logs, dashboards).
  • Integrate personalization, experimentation hooks, and feature flags into the delivery flow.
  • Collaborate closely with mobile/web teams to define contracts and client compatibility.
  • Mentor peers, lead design reviews, and drive API and schema governance and backward-compatibility practices.


Required skills & experience:

  • 7+ years building production microservices and APIs.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with active participation in team ceremonies and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design.
  • Strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) experience, including effective use of abstraction and dependency injection patterns to build modular, testable, and maintainable backend systems.
  • Hands-on development in TypeScript for backend services.
  • Proven RESTful API design and contract experience.
  • Solid experience with databases and caching technologies, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis, with an understanding of data modeling, query performance, and cache strategies.
  • Strong with AWS (API Gateway/Lambda or ECS/EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS/ElastiCache or equivalents).
  • Experience with containerization using Docker (image build, Docker Compose, registries, running services in containers).
  • Strong testing experience, including automated testing and manual verification.
  • Experience with production support: alerting, runbooks, incident management, and on-call duties.
  • Familiar with CI/CD, automated testing, and observability tooling (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, etc.).
  • Good spoken English


Nice to have:

  • Terraform or other IaC for managing AWS resources.
  • Experience instrumenting endpoints and surfacing behavior in analytics platforms such as Amplitude (event schemas, dashboards, alerts).
  • Experience using Statsig, Grafana, and Sentry for experimentation, dashboards, error tracking, and incident diagnostics.
  • Protobuf experience (service/event schema management via service-protos).
  • Background in personalization/experimentation systems.
  • Hands-on development in Python for backend services.


Hiring signals:

  • Examples of evolving APIs without breaking clients and measurable reliability/performance improvements.
  • Proven track record of mentoring and up-skilling engineers—especially enabling teams to adopt and own SDUI patterns.
  • Evidence of effective on-call ownership: resolved incidents, improved runbooks/alerts, postmortems.
  • Code that shows strong testing, observability, and cross-repo contributions.


Perks:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work
  • Flexible PTO
  • Global offices
  • Fun, positive, collaborative environment!



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Account Manager
description:
• LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
  • WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world’s biggest problems?
  • BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world?


Oneday is a VC-backed EdTech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.


We have raised $20M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.


We’re looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.


What you’ll do..

As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:

  • Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who’ve already shown interest
  • Understand what they’re building, why it matters, and where they’re stuck
  • Clearly position Oneday’s programs and mentorship
  • Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
  • Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
  • Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
  • Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates


This is not a passive customer success role.

It’s a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.


You’ll likely do well here if you:

  • Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
  • Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
  • Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
  • Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
  • Take feedback well and apply it
  • Have strong written and spoken English skills
  • Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results


What you’ll get:

  • Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
  • Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

  • WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world’s biggest problems?
  • BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world?


Oneday is a VC-backed EdTech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.


We have raised $20M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.


We’re looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.


What you’ll do..

As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:

  • Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who’ve already shown interest
  • Understand what they’re building, why it matters, and where they’re stuck
  • Clearly position Oneday’s programs and mentorship
  • Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
  • Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
  • Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
  • Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates


This is not a passive customer success role.

It’s a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.


You’ll likely do well here if you:

  • Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
  • Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
  • Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
  • Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
  • Take feedback well and apply it
  • Have strong written and spoken English skills
  • Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results


What you’ll get:

  • Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
  • Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis
